title: E5 derivation certificate
$comment: Transcription of E5 preregistration §6.1, §6.2, §6.3. DELIBERATELY PERMISSIVE in three places so that the frozen rejection ladder of §9.2 stays reachable — see the $comment on schema_version, ruleset_id, conclusion and premises. Tightening any of them silently collapses a distinct reason code into MALFORMED_CERTIFICATE and is a transcription defect, not an improvement.

schema_version.$comment: NOT const. V1 checks the certificate parses; V2 separately checks schema_version == 'E5-CERT/v1' -> UNKNOWN_SCHEMA_VERSION. A const here would make V2 unreachable.

ruleset_id.$comment: NOT const. V3 checks ruleset_id == the embedded ruleset's id -> UNKNOWN_RULESET. A const here would make V3 unreachable, and would break adversarial case A10's sibling reasoning.

steps.$comment: NO minItems. §6.2 calls steps 'ordered, non-empty', but non-emptiness is checked at V7 -> EMPTY_DERIVATION, which runs AFTER V1. A minItems here would report an empty derivation as MALFORMED_CERTIFICATE and make V7 unreachable — the same defect as a const schema_version. An earlier revision had minItems: 1 with a $comment calling the overlap 'harmless'; that reasoning was wrong, and it is exactly the reasoning that collapses a distinct reason code.

GitObjectSha.$comment: Git object name (SHA-1, 40 hex): commit sha for source_revision, blob sha for spec_revision (§5.1). Sha256Hex is only for E5-computed digests (§5.5).

Proposition.$comment: DELIBERATELY STRUCTURAL, NOT a oneOf over P1..P4 of §6.1. V4 checks that the conclusion is a well-formed instance of a frozen shape -> UNKNOWN_CONCLUSION_SHAPE. Validating the four shapes here would make V4 unreachable and would report a bad conclusion as MALFORMED_CERTIFICATE. The four shapes and their fields are carried in E5-RULES-v1.json under 'propositions'; V4 reads them from there.

rule_id.$comment: NOT an enum. V8 checks membership in the embedded ruleset -> UNKNOWN_RULE. An enum here would make V8 unreachable and would report adversarial case A10 as MALFORMED_CERTIFICATE.

premises.$comment: No length constraint. Arity is checked per rule at V9a -> PREMISE_ARITY_MISMATCH (adversarial case A9a).

derived.$comment: The producer's claim. NEVER authority: the verifier recomputes it at V9h and compares -> STEP_PROPOSITION_MISMATCH (adversarial case A8).

PremiseRef.$comment: §6.2. The 'must be < this step's index' rule is NOT expressed here: it is V9b -> PREMISE_FORWARD_REFERENCE. Only 1-basedness is structural.
